teaser.en: A thin, hairy creeper above ground, and below it a buried tuber that can grow as heavy as a sack of maize.
teaser.sw: Juu ya ardhi ni mtambaa mwembamba wenye vinyweleo, na chini yake kiazi kilichozikwa kinachoweza kufikia uzito wa gunia la mahindi.
teaser.dg: Dzulu ya tsi kuna mmea mwembamba unaokpwera, wenye nyere, na tsini ya tsi kuna chiazi chikulu chinachoweza kukala chizito dza gunia ra pemba.

summary.en: *Bundi* is a twining climber with deeply lobed, bristly leaves that grows from a large underground tuber. Digo recognise it by its leaves and that tuber.
summary.sw: *Bundi* ni mtambaa unaojizungusha, wenye majani yenye pindo za kina na manyoya magumu, unaoota kutoka kwenye kiazi kikubwa chini ya ardhi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na kiazi hicho.
summary.dg: *Bundi* ni mmea unaokpwera na kulinga-linga, wenye makodza genye mala mahahu na nyere ngumu, unaomera kula kpwa chiazi chikulu tsini ya tsi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na chiazi hicho.

about.en: *Bundi* is a climbing or trailing plant whose stems die back in the dry season and sprout again from a big buried tuber. The tuber is round to sausage-shaped with smooth brown skin, and can be very large. The leaves are soft but covered in stiff hairs, and are usually cut into three to five deep lobes. Male and female flowers grow on separate plants; they are small and yellow-orange.
about.sw: *Bundi* ni mmea unaopanda au kutambaa, ambao mashina yake hukauka wakati wa kiangazi na kuchipua tena kutoka kwenye kiazi kikubwa kilichozikwa. Kiazi hicho ni cha mviringo hadi umbo la soseji, chenye ngozi laini ya kahawia, na kinaweza kuwa kikubwa sana. Majani yake ni laini lakini yamefunikwa na vinyweleo vigumu, na kwa kawaida yamekatika kuwa pindo tatu hadi tano za kina. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye mimea tofauti; ni madogo na ya manjano-chungwa.
about.dg: *Bundi* ni mmea unaokpwera au unaoambala photsi. Mihiye inauma wakati wa kazikazi, na chisha inatondomera tsona kula kpwa chiazi chikulu chiricho tsini ya tsi. Chiazi ni cha mviringo, au chire dza mkpwahe, chenye gada laini ra rangi ya dongo, na chinaweza kukala chikulu sana. Makodza ni laini, ela gana nyere ngumu, na mara nyinji gana mala mahahu hadi matsano ganayofika ndani sana. Maruwa malume na maruwa ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mimea mbali-mbali; ni madide, ga rangi ya mandano na ya chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in dry scrub, bushland and woodland, often among rocks or on termite mounds, from Ethiopia and Somalia south through Kenya and Tanzania to southern Africa.
where.sw: Huota kwenye vichaka vikavu, vichakani na misituni, mara nyingi katikati ya mawe au juu ya vichuguu, kuanzia Ethiopia na Somalia kusini kupitia Kenya na Tanzania hadi kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya tsi kavu, weruni na matsakani, mara nyinji kahi ya mawe au dzulu ya vidzulu vya lutswa, kula Ethiopia na Somalia, kutsupa Kenya na Tanzania, hadi kusini mwa Afrika.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *bundi* for this climber, and lists it among the names whose meaning cannot be worked out. When identifying it, Digo look at the leaves and the tuber. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *bundi* kwa mtambaa huu, na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina ambayo maana yake haiwezi kufahamika. Wanapoutambua, Wadigo huangalia majani na kiazi. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *bundi* kpwa mmea huno unaokpwera, na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Adigo achiumanya, analola makodzage na chiaziche. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
